metric_cautions: Per-round TD statistics are unweighted residuals on actual sampled moving DDQN targets, not frozen holdout or policy convergence metrics.
mean_smooth_l1_loss is PER IS-weighted; mean_unweighted_smooth_l1_loss is stored inside replay_sampling.
SOC occupancy uses actual interval durations; FC change averages are executed decision-step averages.
Only fixed complete Validation8 or Train35 group costs are comparable. completed_cost_cny for incomplete groups is not a group total.
Signed equivalent-hydrogen cost includes terminal SOC difference credit/debit; no actual terminal recharge or shore cost.
Failure penalties and auxiliary SOC/ramp penalties are reward terms, not actual economic ledger expenses.
